sources.name: minigrid_fourrooms_expert_family
sources.note: Four-room doorway and intersection routing patterns adapted into the Roblox 88-value maze sensor schema.

sources.name: pointmaze_umaze_qiteration_family
sources.note: Uses the published U-Maze topology and shortest-path waypoint behavior, re-encoded into Roblox-relative actions.

sources.name: antmaze_medium_diverse_family
sources.note: Uses the published medium AntMaze topology for longer route planning while discarding Ant motor controls.

sources.name: maze_dataset_dfs_family
sources.note: Randomized DFS perfect-maze family with optimal A* demonstrations.

sources.name: maze_dataset_prim_loop_family
sources.note: Branching and loop-rich maze family with optimal A* demonstrations.

sources.name: iastar_grid_planning_family
sources.note: 32x32-style obstacle, gap and bug-trap path-planning layouts with optimal A* actions.

sources.name: micromouse_navigation_family
sources.note: Dense 16x16 maze topology family modeled after classic Micromouse navigation problems.

sources.name: roblox_pathfinding_teacher_family
sources.note: Roblox-scale room/corridor and obstacle layouts solved with the same waypoint-teacher concept used by PathfindingService.
